import pytest
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor, SpanExporter, SpanExportResult
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import ReadableSpan
from langfuse._client.span_processor import LangfuseSpanProcessor

class RecordingExporter(SpanExporter):
    def __init__(self):
        self.spans = []

    def export(self, spans):
        self.spans.extend(spans)
        return SpanExportResult.SUCCESS

    def shutdown(self):
        pass

def make_span(provider, name):
    tracer = provider.get_tracer("test")
    with tracer.start_as_current_span(name):
        pass

def test_set_should_export_span_affects_export():
    # processor with default filter (exports)
    exporter1 = RecordingExporter()
    processor1 = LangfuseSpanProcessor(
        public_key="pk",
        secret_key="sk",
        base_url="http://example.com",
        span_exporter=exporter1,
    )
    provider1 = TracerProvider()
    provider1.add_span_processor(processor1)
    make_span(provider1, "span1")
    provider1.shutdown()
    assert len(exporter1.spans) == 1
    # processor with custom filter that drops spans
    exporter2 = RecordingExporter()
    processor2 = LangfuseSpanProcessor(
        public_key="pk",
        secret_key="sk",
        base_url="http://example.com",
        span_exporter=exporter2,
    )
    # set filter to always False
    processor2.set_should_export_span(lambda span: False)
    provider2 = TracerProvider()
    provider2.add_span_processor(processor2)
    make_span(provider2, "span2")
    provider2.shutdown()
    assert len(exporter2.spans) == 0
